key.name: low-battery-level
key.description: The charge, in percent, at or below which a controller's battery counts as low and its icon turns orange.

key.name: low-battery-alerts
key.description: Whether to send a notification when a controller's battery reaches the low level, and again at 10%.

key.name: connection-notices
key.description: Whether to send a notification when a controller connects or disconnects.

key.name: show-battery-level
key.summary: Battery level in the top bar
key.description: Whether to show the battery level beside the top-bar icon. With several controllers, the lowest charge is shown.

key.name: hide-when-disconnected
key.summary: Hide the icon without a controller
key.description: Whether to hide the top-bar icon while no controller is connected. It comes back as soon as one connects.

key.name: keep-awake
key.description: Whether controller input counts as activity, so the screen does not dim and lock while a controller is in use. While it is on and a controller is connected, Padlight reads the controller in the background.

key.name: nicknames
key.description: Each controller's nickname and its model's name, under a key made from the controller's Bluetooth address or USB serial number and the nickname salt. The address and the serial number themselves are not kept.

key.name: nickname-salt
key.description: Random text, made when the first nickname is set, that goes into every nickname's key, so the same controller has a different key on another computer.
